items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Lou Singer -- he was on a couple of tunes of mine... Lou Singer did do a couple of things for me on my songs

ctx.x: He used to make piano parts for the publishing companies and so forth. But Lou Singer -- he was on a couple of tunes of mine, though I have forgotten the names, and I guess that's why it's written in there on that tune.
How about 'Pyramid?' That one is listed -- one time it's listed by Tizol and Ellington and then the next time it is Tizol, Ellington and Mills.
